messages.subject: Ridge marginals
parts:
Hi,
I am doing a ridge regression in the same way as in the Stack example you provide on the website, e.g.:
formula.ridge  = y  ~ f(beta1, air, model="iid", values = c(1,2,3),
        hyper = param.beta) +
    f(beta2, temp, copy="beta1", fixed=T) +
    f(beta3, acid, copy="beta1", fixed=T)

I would like to obtain the posterior marginals of the beta coefficients, how can I do that?
The component summary.random only contains NA's.
Thank you very much for your help,
Gwenael
